plugin_desc: Huawei WLAN AC SNMP collection for campus WLAN controllers. In addition to entity CPU, memory and temperature plus IF-MIB uplink traffic, it collects joined/normal AP counts, station counts by band, global wireless speed, VAP scale, per-AP run state/CPU/memory/temperature/online users, and per-radio run state, channel, noise, utilization, free airtime and STA counts. Supported brands/models include Huawei AC6005, AC650x and AirEngine 9700 WLAN controllers (sysObjectID family 1.3.6.1.4.1.2011.2.240).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the wireless controller since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Per-entity CPU utilization of the Huawei WLAN AC (hwEntityCpuUsage), normalized to a 0-100 percentage. Dimension descr is entPhysicalName. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate heavy AP or station management load.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Per-entity memory utilization of the Huawei WLAN AC (hwEntityMemUsage), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. High memory pressure can affect AP join handling and station roaming.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature reading of each Huawei WLAN AC hardware sensor (hwEntityTemperature), in degrees Celsius. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat.

metrics.name: interface_ifOperStatus
metrics.description: Actual operational status of each WLAN AC uplink or service interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifHighSpeed
metrics.description: Interface speed in megabits per second from IF-MIB ifHighSpeed on the WLAN AC uplink.

metrics.name: interface_ifInErrors
metrics.description: Average rate of incoming error packets over the past 5 minutes on WLAN AC interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutErrors
metrics.description: Average rate of outgoing error packets over the past 5 minutes on WLAN AC interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifInDiscards
metrics.description: Average rate of incoming discarded packets over the past 5 minutes on WLAN AC interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutDiscards
metrics.description: Average rate of outgoing discarded packets over the past 5 minutes on WLAN AC interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: Average inbound byte rate over the past 5 minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter on the WLAN AC uplink.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: Average outbound byte rate over the past 5 minutes from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter on the WLAN AC uplink.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: Average total inbound byte rate of the WLAN AC over the past 5 minutes, summed across interfaces from ifHCInOctets.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: Average total outbound byte rate of the WLAN AC over the past 5 minutes, summed across interfaces from ifHCOutOctets.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_joint_ap_num
metrics.description: Current number of APs joined to this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanCurJointApNum). A sudden drop means APs went offline from the controller.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_count
metrics.description: AP count reported by the Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanApCount). Compare with joined and normal AP counts to spot inventory drift.

metrics.name: wlan_service_normal_ap_count
metrics.description: Number of APs in normal service on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanServiceNormalAPCount). Lower than joined AP count means some APs are joined but not serving.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_normal_ratio
metrics.description: Ratio of normal-service APs on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanApNormalRatio), as a 0-100 percentage. A falling ratio is an early fleet-health signal.

metrics.name: wlan_access_max_ap_number
metrics.description: Maximum AP number allowed on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanAccessMaxApNumber). Joined AP count approaching this value means the controller is near license or scale capacity.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_assoc_sta_num
metrics.description: Current associated station count on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanCurAssocStaNum). Sudden drops can indicate RF, authentication, or controller faults.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_auth_success_sta_num
metrics.description: Current stations that completed authentication on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanCurAuthSuccessStaNum). A growing gap versus associated count points to auth failures.

metrics.name: wlan_sta_cur_num
metrics.description: Current station count on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanStaCurNum). Use it together with associated and auth-success counts when the three objects disagree across software versions.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_assoc_2g_sta_num
metrics.description: Current associated 2.4 GHz station count (hwWlanCurAssoc2gStaNum). Useful for band-steering and 2.4 GHz congestion checks.

metrics.name: wlan_cur_assoc_5g_sta_num
metrics.description: Current associated 5 GHz station count (hwWlanCurAssoc5gStaNum).

metrics.name: wlan_cur_assoc_6g_sta_num
metrics.description: Current associated 6 GHz station count (hwWlanCurAssoc6gStaNum). Missing values are expected on ACs or APs without 6 GHz radios.

metrics.name: wlan_access_max_sta_number
metrics.description: Maximum station number allowed on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanAccessMaxStaNumber). Associated count approaching this value means the controller is near station scale capacity.

metrics.name: wlan_global_up_speed
metrics.description: Global wireless uplink speed reported by the Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanGlobalUpSpeed).

metrics.name: wlan_global_down_speed
metrics.description: Global wireless downlink speed reported by the Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanGlobalDownSpeed).

metrics.name: wlan_vap_cur_num
metrics.description: Current VAP count on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwVapCurNum). Unexpected change can mean SSID deployment drift.

metrics.name: wlan_vap_max_num
metrics.description: Maximum VAP count on this Huawei WLAN AC (hwVapMaxNum). Current VAP count approaching this value means the controller is near VAP scale capacity.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_run_state
metrics.description: Run state of each AP managed by this Huawei WLAN AC (hwWlanApRunState). Fault, configFailed, or idle on an AP that should be serving clients needs immediate investigation.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of each managed AP (hwWlanApCpuUsage), as a 0-100 percentage. High AP CPU can drop clients or delay roaming.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_mem_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of each managed AP (hwWlanApMemUsage), as a 0-100 percentage. High AP memory can cause restarts or client association failures.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_temperature
metrics.description: Temperature of each managed AP (hwWlanApTemperature), in degrees Celsius. High values on indoor or outdoor APs indicate cooling or ambient issues.

metrics.name: wlan_ap_online_user_num
metrics.description: Online user count of each managed AP (hwWlanApOnlineUserNum). Combined with radio STA counts it locates overloaded APs.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_run_state
metrics.description: Run state of each radio (hwWlanRadioRunState). A down radio means that band is not serving clients even if the AP is joined.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_channel
metrics.description: Operating channel of each radio (hwWlanRadioChannel). Unexpected channel changes can indicate radar events or RF planning drift.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_noise
metrics.description: Noise reading of each radio (hwWlanRadioNoise). Rising noise reduces SNR and client throughput.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_util
metrics.description: Channel utilization of each radio (hwWlanRadioUtilization), as a 0-100 percentage. High utilization with modest STA count often means interference or neighbor BSS load.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_free
metrics.description: Free airtime of each radio (hwWlanRadioFree), as a 0-100 percentage. Low free airtime means the radio cannot accept more load without quality loss.

metrics.name: wlan_radio_sta_num
metrics.description: Current station count of each radio (hwWlanRadioStaNum).

metrics.name: wlan_radio_sta_max
metrics.description: Maximum station count of each radio (hwWlanRadioMaxStaNum). Current count approaching max means that radio is near association capacity.
